comment: Material layers (texture-array slices). Index = order. scale = metres per texture repeat; strength = how strongly the painted detail modulates the palette tint; normal = normal-map strength. Source paintings live in art/materials/source/<name>.png (AI-generated, recorded with provenance). Run art/tools/make_materials.py after changing anything here.
style: Seamless tileable square texture, top-down orthographic view, hand-painted stylized game texture for a cozy toy-like low-poly game, soft painterly brush strokes, even flat lighting with no cast shadows or vignette, neutral light grey colour with only subtle hue variation so it can be tinted later, no text, no border, edges must tile seamlessly.
